mstts:express-as.prosody: As we wrap up, let's take a moment to pull together what modern romance is really teaching us. Sure, technology gives us more options than ever before, but it can make things like commitment and clarity a bit trickier. The way we use our phones and apps? That shapes our intimacy, for better or worse—depending on how intentional we are. These days, searching for love isn't just about finding someone else—it's about discovering more of who you are along the way. And when it comes down to it, honest communication, even when it's tough, is worth so much more than just avoiding the hard stuff. At the heart of it all, our core needs—intimacy and understanding—they haven't changed, even as the ways we connect keep evolving. If you ever feel overwhelmed by endless choices, that pressure to be perfect, or the constant buzz of notifications, just know you're not the only one. We're all figuring it out—making mistakes, trying again, and learning as we go. So, here's what this means for you: be gentle with yourself and with others. Choose honesty over avoidance, presence over distraction, and let your curiosity lead the way instead of cynicism. The tools might change, but the heart's desire for real connection? That stays the same. In the end, love isn’t about finding the perfect person—it's about building something real, one imperfect moment at a time. So keep showing up, keep hoping, and let your own story unfold. You've got this.
